races.paceDynamic: Reliable Ricki, Stay Salty, and Indefensible will ensure a strong gallop from the start with all three natural front-runners likely to contest the early lead. This sustained pace over Doncaster's sharp mile will create significant stamina demands, particularly with Good to Firm conditions encouraging speed. The relentless gallop should stretch the field and expose any stamina limitations in the closing stages. This race shape strongly favors hold-up horses like Thunderhoof, Horu Kanu, and Decem Starr who can capitalize on the inevitable pace collapse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners maintain a fierce gallop through halfway and beyond
scenarios.body: The sustained speed will drain the leaders' stamina reserves, setting up a tactical finish where patient hold-up horses can strike late. Fresh finishers with proven stamina will sweep past tired pace-setters in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters can dictate more measured fractions while maintaining the lead
scenarios.body: A canny front-runner could steal crucial lengths by controlling the tempo, making it difficult for closers to reel them in despite the strong pace. Stay Salty's class or Reliable Ricki's freshness could prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If the pace proves too strong for both leaders and hold-up horses to handle effectively
scenarios.body: The middle-ground runners tracking the pace without setting it could find the perfect position to strike, avoiding both pace pressure and having too much ground to make up. Vidmiyr and Lady Hornblower are ideally positioned.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners engage in an early speed battle that compromises all pace angles
scenarios.body: A destructive early pace war could eliminate both leaders and hold-up horses, creating an unpredictable scramble where any runner finding clear running could prevail. The most balanced horse on the day takes advantage.

watchPoints.text: Stay Salty's fitness after 61-day layoff could see him fade badly if forced into early pace pressure with fresher speed horses
Reliable Ricki's 224-day absence means his true fitness level remains unknown despite trainer George Scott's recent good form
Decem Starr's headgear addition suggests connections expect improvement and could signal a significant performance boost
The three confirmed front-runners creating early fractions that could set up an unusually strong pace for a nine-runner field
Thunderhoof and Horu Kanu both needing clear runs from their hold-up positions to capitalize on the anticipated pace scenario

races.paceDynamic: Rose Of Honour will take the field along as the sole natural front runner, setting a manageable pace without early pressure. Territorial Knight and Brummell may track prominently but neither has the early speed to challenge Rose Of Honour's lead through the first half. The lack of pace pressure means Rose Of Honour can dictate terms while the hold-up brigade of Akkadian Thunder, Rousing Encore, and Papa Cocktail will need the pace to collapse late. This tactical scenario strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid traffic problems in a small field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Rose Of Honour faces no early pressure and maintains kick
scenarios.body: Rose Of Honour sets comfortable fractions and has enough left to repel late challenges in this small field. The 215-day break becomes irrelevant with soft early splits allowing her class to show.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Rose Of Honour sets the pace but fades in final furlong
scenarios.body: Territorial Knight or Brummell can track the leader closely and pounce when Rose Of Honour's long absence tells. Their prominent style perfectly suits picking up the pieces from a tiring leader.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes unexpectedly strong through mid-race pressure
scenarios.body: Akkadian Thunder gets the strong pace he needs to unleash his finishing kick from the rear. His recent second at Pontefract shows he's in good form and ready to strike.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Rose Of Honour goes too slowly and field bunches entering straight
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where Papa Cocktail's recent consistency gives him an edge. All hold-up horses benefit but Papa Cocktail has the best recent form pattern.

watchPoints.text: Rose Of Honour must break alertly to establish position - any sluggish start ruins her tactical advantage
Territorial Knight with apprentice jockey Mason Paetel could get caught wide if pace is slow and field bunches
Brummell's fitness after 182-day break will show early - watch for any signs of ring-rustiness in preliminaries
Papa Cocktail needs room to manoeuvre in straight - small field helps but still needs clear passage
Track Akkadian Thunder's position turning for home - if too far back when pace is slow he cannot win

races.paceDynamic: Mafting is the lone front runner and will get an uncontested lead from the break, setting a comfortable pace over this 1m4f trip. With Sixpack and Pleasant Man likely settling prominent but not pressuring early, Mafting can dictate fractions without interference. The three hold-up horses (Saratoga Gold, Tazaman, Dreams Fled Away) will be relying on a strong finish from off the pace. This setup strongly favours the front runner and prominent racers, as the lack of early pressure allows them to control the race and have something left for the finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Mafting Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Mafting gets the expected soft lead and maintains rhythm
scenarios.body: Daniel Tudhope can judge the fractions perfectly and the recent winner proves too strong when challenged. The prominent runners get first run but can't peg back the leader who has conserved energy early.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Sixpack or Pleasant Man can get close enough to challenge strongly
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on good-to-firm going while the prominent runners benefit from tracking the leader. Pleasant Man's recent form gives him the edge in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too strong or the hold-up horses get perfect runs
scenarios.body: Saratoga Gold or Tazaman benefit from a truly-run race where the early leaders come back to them. The 156-day break could see Saratoga Gold primed for a big run after his good form when last seen.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Mafting goes too slow and gets swamped late
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where class tells and the closers get maximum benefit. Dreams Fled Away's long absence makes this unlikely but not impossible if the fractions suit.

races.paceDynamic: Grey Force is the only confirmed front runner and should get an uncontested lead at a sustainable gallop over this 7f trip. With eight hold-up horses behind including Tekitoff, Too Darn Spicy, and Trucial Pearl, this sets up as a classic scenario where the pace-setter controls the tempo without pressure. The lack of early pace means Grey Force can dictate fractions and potentially steal a march on the field. This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can track the leader, as the hold-up brigade will face a wall of traffic and may struggle to make up ground if Grey Force gets first run.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Grey Force Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Grey Force gets away with soft fractions and isn't challenged early
scenarios.body: The leader can save energy for the final furlong while the packed hold-up horses struggle for racing room. Grey Force's sustainable pace advantage becomes decisive when the cavalry charge arrives too late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses can secure clear runs and Grey Force's stamina cracks
scenarios.body: The superior class of horses like Tekitoff and Too Darn Spicy tells in the final 100 yards despite the tactical disadvantage. Racing room opens up at the crucial moment allowing the better horses to strike.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Causes Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the large group of hold-up horses creates a bottleneck turning for home
scenarios.body: Several fancied runners get hampered or blocked, allowing an outsider with a cleaner passage to capitalize. The race becomes more about luck and positioning than pure ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Prominent Runner
scenarios.trigger: If one of the supposed hold-up horses breaks character and races prominently
scenarios.body: A tactical switch catches the field off guard and that horse gets the perfect stalking position behind Grey Force. They can strike at the ideal moment without the traffic problems.

watchPoints.text: Grey Force gets soft early fractions and builds an unassailable lead before the hold-up horses can organize

Tekitoff and Too Darn Spicy secure clear runs despite tactical disadvantage as the classiest hold-up performers
Caitlin G and Go Teejay show their usual fading patterns when racing gets serious in final furlong
Any horse that breaks from hold-up tactics and races prominently gains significant tactical advantage

races.paceDynamic: Magic Music and Lumenbourg will contest the early lead, with Magic Music likely to go forward from the off and Lumenbourg content to race alongside. Behind them, Straight A and Mr Cool will sit prominent while the majority of the field (Zubaru, Maxi Boy, Evocative Spark, Chifa, Valentine Catcher, Oscar's Sister) will settle in behind. The dual pace angle should create an honest gallop over this 7f trip at Doncaster, with the leaders likely to come under pressure from halfway. This race shape clearly favours the hold-up horses who can benefit from the strong early pace and finish off the honest gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Magic Music and Lumenbourg maintain a solid gallop to halfway
scenarios.body: The strong early pace will set up perfectly for the closers who can pick up the pieces in the final 2f. Evocative Spark, Zubaru and Valentine Catcher are best positioned to capitalise on this likely scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent trackers strike
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is more modest than expected between the leaders
scenarios.body: Straight A and Mr Cool can position themselves perfectly to strike when the pace lifts, avoiding the trap of going too early or leaving themselves too much to do. Their prominent position becomes the winning move.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runners stay there
scenarios.trigger: If Magic Music kicks clear approaching the 2f pole
scenarios.body: A single leader getting first run can prove hard to peg back on good going, especially if the hold-up horses get into a bumping match behind. Magic Music's low weight and willing attitude could see him go all the way.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too fast early and stop quickly
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish from the back where pure speed matters most, though this seems unlikely given both front-runners' recent form suggests they can sustain their effort. Late speed becomes everything.
